name: Joshua Heidorn
headline: Full-Stack Software Engineer
headlines: Full-Stack Engineer Working on AI Tooling
summary: Full-stack software engineer with 10+ years of experience building scalable applications, developer tools, and AI-powered systems. Strong expertise in React and TypeScript with a focus on user experience, interface optimization, and workflow improvement. Currently building an AI tool named MyPalClara (a LangGraph-based agentic assistant and companion). Experienced leading development teams in security-focused environments and comfortable wherever reliability matters.

Subcontracted to the US Air Force supporting the LIMS Lifecycle application team, building mission-critical features under stringent security and compliance requirements.
Led comprehensive refactoring of legacy code to improve readability and maintainability for mission-critical operations.
Collaborated directly with customers to gather requirements and implement UI features informed by real user feedback.
Created comprehensive technical documentation and training materials that measurably improved team productivity.
Led development teams in an Agile environment, planning sprints and running standups to deliver multiple enterprise applications on schedule.
Drove a 20% improvement in application speed and reliability through a modernization of the Forms UI and backend.
Managed multiple applications across the suite including Forms, Equipment Tracker, Tag-it-Bot, and Authentication.
Mentored junior developers, established coding standards, and participated in performance reviews and hiring interviews.
Partnered with sales, customer success, and engineering stakeholders to align technical work with business goals and funding estimates.
Progressed from Associate Product Developer to Lead Product Development Manager, taking complete ownership of the Forms application.
Built and maintained React/TypeScript interfaces for enterprise solutions serving thousands of users.
Established timelines, goals, and funding estimates for both short- and long-term development projects; led client meetings to align objectives.
Developed and maintained a custom Apache Solr implementation used across internal and customer-facing applications.
Served as PDLP (Product Developer Learning Path) mentor to junior developers across multiple application teams.
Contributed to a company-wide initiative converting existing pages to Bootstrap 4.
